A couple of months ago, he tried to take his own life by getting drunk and swallowing a bottle of acetaminophen. He and I are extremely close and he only talks to me. Would I be an asshole if I live a lie for the rest of my life to make my brother feel he's not alone and possibly help him move forward in life?
